title: The Transgression by the Shore
intro: You stand upon the sands of a forgotten shore, where the waves whisper of a community tested by a divine command. The air is heavy with the memory of a violation that led to a startling transformation. Who were these souls, and what was the nature of their trial?
clues: We were a community that received a clear commandment from our Lord, yet we found ways to defy it.
We lived near a body of water, and our livelihood depended on its creatures.
A test came to us on the day we were commanded to refrain from worldly pursuits.
The creatures of the water came to us in great numbers on that very day, tempting us beyond endurance.
We devised a cunning trick to circumvent the divine order, thinking we could outsmart the decree.
Our transgression led to a humiliating transformation; we became despised apes by the command of Allah.

outcome.label: Outcome

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
